platform_info.name: TikTok
platform_info.description: Handles DDPs in English and Dutch. For the JSON format, both user_data.json and user_data_tiktok.json are tried automatically. English DDPs in TXT format have not yet been tested. If you find anything wrong with the data donation flows, please report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

description.en: Summary counts of videos watched, commented on, and shared since account registration.
description.nl: Overzicht van het aantal bekeken, becommentarieerde en gedeelde video's sinds registratie.

documentation.summary: Summary counts of TikTok activity measures since account registration, such as the number of videos watched, commented on, and shared.

columns.Count: Total count for that metric since account registration.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one TikTok video the participant watched, including the date and video link.

columns.Date: Timestamp of when the video was watched.
columns.Link: URL of the watched TikTok video.

description.en: Videos you have marked as favorites on TikTok.
description.nl: Video's die je als favoriet hebt gemarkeerd op TikTok.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one TikTok video the participant marked as a favorite.

columns.Date: Timestamp of when the video was marked as favorite.
columns.Link: URL of the favorited TikTok video.

description.en: Accounts that follow you on TikTok.
description.nl: Accounts die jou volgen op TikTok.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one account that follows the participant on TikTok.

columns.Date: Timestamp of when the account started following.

description.nl: Accounts die je volgt op TikTok.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one account that the participant follows on TikTok.

columns.Date: Timestamp of when the participant started following this account.

description.en: Videos you have liked on TikTok.
description.nl: Video's die je leuk hebt gevonden op TikTok.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one TikTok video the participant liked.

columns.Date: Timestamp of when the video was liked.
columns.Link: URL of the liked TikTok video.

title.en: Most common words in your comments
title.nl: Meest voorkomende woorden in je reacties

documentation.summary: Each row represents one comment the participant left on a TikTok video.

columns.Date: Timestamp of when the comment was posted.
columns.Photo: Photo associated with the comment, if any.
